subject: Acme — Post-call recap & cost model
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme — Post-call recap & cost model

Hi Alice — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Call summary:
- Use case: In-product assistant for support and recommendations (FAQ + contextual follow-ups).
- Models discussed: redwood-mix-8b for generation, embeddings for rerank/search.
- Key success metric: latency < 350ms p50 for user-facing flows; cost target aligned with ACME procurement (see below).

Assumptions we used for a first-pass cost model (attached: acme-cost-model-v3.xlsx):
- Monthly active users (MAU): 50,000
- Avg sessions per MAU / month: 3
- Avg tokens per session: prompt 500 tokens + model reply 250 tokens = 750 tokens/session
- Monthly token volume = 50k * 3 * 750 = ~112,500,000 tokens (~0.1125B)
- Peak QPS estimate: 60 (we can refine with telemetry)

Unit economics & proposed pricing guidance:
- Baseline Redwood list: $450 / 1M tokens (hosted, public tier)
- Target for ACME (initial PO): $320 / 1M tokens with commit and modest discount schedule at scale (volume bands)
- Support & SLAs: included basic support; premium SLAs are additional line items

High-level monthly estimate (rough):
- Token charge (at $320 / 1M): $36,000 / month (~$432k / year)
- Additional ops (egress, storage, embedding lookups): ~$1,500 / month
- One-time onboarding & evaluation credits: TBD

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the MAU and sessions assumptions (or share an internal forecast CSV)?
2) Procurement contact and preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly vs annual)?
3) If those look good, I’ll send a formal invoice estimate + updated cost model and proposed SOW.

I attached the initial cost model (acme-cost-model-v3.xlsx). I’ll follow up with a tightened invoice estimate once I have your budget range and procurement lead.

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
From: Alice Monroe <alice@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Harris <ben.harris@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme — Post-call recap & cost model

Thanks Sean — useful summary. A couple clarifications from my side: 

- The MAU assumption is roughly correct but our internal forecast (attached) shows a phased ramp: month 1 = 10k MAU, month 6 = 45k, month 12 = 120k. I attached Acme_usage_forecast.csv.
- Budget: procurement gave a target annual budget range for proof-of-concept and first year of $150k–$250k; they asked whether we can structure costs to hit a $/1M token closer to $250–$300 if we commit to a 12-month plan.
- Billing: prefer monthly invoices but can do quarterly if needed for contract timing.

Can you produce an invoice estimate that shows both an initial POC band (10–45k MAU) and a scaled band (45–120k MAU) with unit economics for each band? Also please show the impact of a committed 12-month contract vs month-to-month.

Thanks — Alice Monroe
Director, Product & Innovation
Acme Corp
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme — Post-call recap & cost model

Appreciate the forecast, Alice — that ramp helps a lot. I updated the model and attached an invoice-style estimate (acme-invoice-estimate-20260311.pdf) plus the revised spreadsheet (acme-cost-model-v4.xlsx). Summary below.

Invoice estimate highlights (monthly view):
- POC band (10k → 45k MAU; avg tokens/month ~30M – 135M): unit price options
  - Month-to-month: $420 / 1M tokens → POC monthly range: $12,600 – $56,700
  - 12-month committed: $300 / 1M tokens → POC monthly range: $9,000 – $40,500
- Scaled band (45k → 120k MAU; avg tokens/month ~135M – 360M):
  - Month-to-month: $400 / 1M tokens → $54,000 – $144,000 / month
  - 12-month committed: $260 / 1M tokens (volume discount) → $35,100 – $93,600 / month

Line items in the attached PDF: compute token charges, embedding lookups (per-embedding unit), egress, optional premium support, and a negotiated onboarding credit. I also included a target metric column for cost / 1M tokens so procurement can see the breakpoint for a $/1M of $250, $300, $320 etc.

Key asks back to you: 
- Confirm whether procurement can consider a 12-month commit (we can structure a stepped discount tied to monthly volume).
- Provide procurement contact (procurement@acme.com copied?) so we can route an initial SOW + invoice.

If that looks good, Marissa (CC) will draft a formal commercial proposal and SOW.

Thanks — Sean
(sean signature)

Attachments: acme-invoice-estimate-20260311.pdf, acme-cost-model-v4.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme — Post-call recap & cost model (internal)

Looping internal ops: I reviewed Sean's estimate and the numbers look within play. Recommendation: offer the 12-month committed pricing with a 3-month trial at month-to-month rates and a credit applied at month 4 if they convert to commit. That hits Alice's procurement target toward $250–$300 / 1M effective cost while protecting us on initial usage.

Next steps (internal):
- Neha: please draft the commercial proposal and include the SOW + monthly invoice template; mark as Deal ID ACME-2026-045.
- Sean: confirm procurement contact and whether Acme needs PO terms or a supplier form.
- I will be the AE owner and will coordinate legal for a 12-month SOW.

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
